QUOTE: Anything classified binary is dropped before doxygen or any parser sees it (`filetypes.py`, `cli.py:_drop_binary_files`). ... JS/TS and other claimed types (`synth.py:claims`) are not read by doxygen. They come from the parse-built front end, using the same scanned file set.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names both filters (binary classification dropping files, and the parse-built front end claiming types doxygen can't read) as steps applied after scope resolution. Its binary-filter description doesn't mention extensions that lie, but the item only requires naming at least one of the two filters.
